name: Reckoner Staff
bio: No bio available

name: Akshaya Harendran
bio: Akshaya Harendran is a print board member and a grade 10 student. She's married to her Spotify (and Alex Turner), likes reading (since her life lacks a lot), singing, sleeping, and is always capturing moments with her loved ones.

name: Alvin Pan
bio: Alvin Pan, currently Grade 10 student is a member of the News board and editorial at the Reckoner, this is his first year as a part of the team. He loves playing chess and you're most likely to see him roaming the nearest McDonald's.

name: Andrew Xu
bio: Andrew Xu is a grade 12 Editorial Board writer.

name: Annabella Pang
bio: Annabella is a grade 9 student that is part of the photography board. She enjoys reading, hanging out with friends, watching movies, and of course, taking pictures. Annabella loves making new friends so don't be afraid to reach out to her! Her favourite quote is "We may encounter many defeats but we must not be defeated." -Maya Angelou

name: Anne Liu
bio: Anne Liu is a Grade 12 student and the News Manager for the Thirteenth Guard. She loves ballet, listening to music, and making her own bubble tea. If you ever see her in the halls, don't be afraid to say hi!

name: Caroline Cheng
bio: Caroline Cheng is one of the Print Managers of the Reckoner. She enjoys watching anime and she thinks that tea is way better than coffee. Her bio seems to have gotten shorter over the years.

name: Chang Li
bio: Chang is a grade 11 student at Marc Garneau Collegiate Institute, and will be your 13th Guard Editorial Manager. Outside of obsessing over school and talking in a high-pitched nasally voice, Chang enjoys to sew, play chess, complete jigsaw puzzles, and even just hang out with his friends— although they're probably getting a bit tired of him at this point. Feel free to say hi to him in the hallways, just don't bring up anything related to height or he might break down in tears.

name: Corey Dai
bio: Corey Dai. This kid doesn't know what he's doing. He's just there.

name: Daniel Long
bio: Daniel is a Grade 12 student who is a member of the web board. He likes skating, programming, and making things look cool on screens. In case one needs proof of his ability as a web team member, just look at his glasses. All computer guys have glasses.

name: Don Tran
bio: Don Tran?? Oh, that guy. Yeah he's an 11er and member of both Outreach and Print boards. He plays volleyball and violin in his free time , while also barely holding together the threads of his social life outside of school. He prays every night that the upcoming tests will be sleepable (they aren't) and has trouble starting assignments more than 12 hours before due. All good. Not that serious.

name: Elizabeth Wei
bio: Elizabeth is a grade 12 artist for the life board and enjoys lying down next to her cats, hoping they will tolerate her. Her hobbies include drawing, crocheting, playing volleyball, and meticulously time blocking every event and assignment in their master calendar. Her favourite series is Mob Psycho 100, and she likes collecting keychains that she’ll never use.

name: Emilee Zhang
bio: Emilee Zhang is an individual who identifies as a female and goes by pronouns she/her, currently in 10th grade. She enjoys doing art and playing video games in her spare time.

name: Emily Guo
bio: Emily is a Grade 9 TOPS student at MGCI. She is in Print and Web Development, where she puts aesthetics onto aesthetics to make something aesthetic. She enjoys a variety of things, including the sciences (+ computer science!!), anime, and grinding mobile games. Emily is also a manga enthusiast who needs to read less manga and focus more on school (please do your work).

name: Emily Ma
bio: Emily is part of the Editorial Board at The Reckoner. She enjoys reading, hanging out with friends, and watching musicals.

name: Emily Pan
bio: Hey Garneau! Meet Emily Pan, one of the illustrators for the Reckoner. Stay tuned for super awesome art from the illustration board!

name: Eric Tang
bio: Imagine having a seasoned darts player, lover of Chipotle burrito bowls, and a guy that can wiggle his ears working on The Reckoner. Meet Eric. He’s a Grade 12 student and one of the Print Board’s Co-Directors. He’s a big fan of British bands; The Narcissist by Blur is his current song on repeat. He also enjoys bingeing movies. In his opinion, Cars 2 is the best sequel ever made. Eric’s grand goal in life is to own every Lego Star Wars set ever produced and to visit all of America’s national parks. Join the print board!

name: Faseeh Ahmed
bio: Faseeh is a grade 11 student who loves baking, playing video games and editing videos. When he's not doing any of those he tries to stay active by going to the gym or to the local park. On a side note, ducks are the best animal!

name: Fiona Chan
bio: Fiona is a grade ten student for the Illustrations board. She enjoys listening to music, scrolling on Pinterest and online stores, and drawing.

name: Glenn Huang
bio: Glenn Huang is a grade 10 student at MGCI and a member of the print board. In his spare time, he enjoys listening to music and scrolling endlessly through reels. His goals for this year are to reduce his screen time and become less socially awkward.

name: Grace Pu
bio: Grace Pu is a grade 12 writer for the Significant Digits News Board. Her hobbies include biking, reading, and watching YouTube.

name: Grace Zhu
bio: absolutely insane about everything

name: Grant Ou
bio: Grant is pro

name: Han Fang
bio: Han is a grade 12 student at MGCI, and is a part of the Print Development and Web Development Boards on the Reckoner. He likes to play sports, chess, watch YouTube, and has (in time of writing) recently learned how to play poker.

name: Hania Ahmed
bio: Hania Ahmed is in Grade 10 and is an artist for the Life Board. She enjoys painting, writing, and sketching. She is passionate about creating art.

name: Hanna Naseri
bio: Hanna Naseri, driven by a passion for writing and journalism, has officially become a member of the editorial board for The Reckoner, MGCI school newspaper. She demonstrates a strong belief in equitable work and ethical journalism. She promotes meticulous fact-checking, impartial coverage, and responsible reporting, serving as an important board member and a source of journalistic inspiration within our community.

name: Hannah Xu
bio: Hannah is a Grade 11 artist for Life Board! She loves shopping, amusement parks, jigsaw puzzles, and cotton candy.

name: Harris Abraham
bio: Harris Abraham is a sophomore Editorial Board writer. He's known in the school for his energetic personality and charisma, and aims to bring engaging literature to the student body.

name: Jeffrey Zhu
bio: Jeffrey is a grade 11 student who enjoys taking pictures. If he isn't flying his drone or camping in minus 30-degree temperatures, you can find him in room 102 acquiring character with a 120-pound metal robot. He also enjoys taking too many risks and ambulance rides.

name: Jerry Hong
bio: Jerry Hong is a grade 11 student trying to figure out why school got so hard. He is a writer for the Life Board at The Reckoner. He likes to spend his free time practicing piano, going outside with his friends, and playing badminton.

name: Jessica Sun
bio: Jessica Sun is a Grade 11 student on the Outreach Board for her third year. On her own time, she listens to audiobooks and observes her gardening progress.

name: Justin Wei
bio: Justin is a Grade 12 student and the photography manager for The Reckoner. He likes to read the news every day (maybe that's why he wrote for Significant Digits the past three years) and needs to touch grass every other day. If you ever see him outside, Justin is probably on his bike or hiking. Check out his photos on Unsplash!

name: Kenny Zheng
bio: From the urbanely sprawling Region of Greater Golden Horseshoe, it's the controversially acclaimed Kenster Avenger. 416-439-0000. Grade 11. Life. Eat Fresh.

name: Komal Dagar
bio: With over 20,000 photos in her camera roll, Komal captures a photo in any moment. Grateful to be accepted into the Reckoner photography board, shes ready to capture a photo for any moment.

name: Ladan Hassan
bio: Ladan Hassan is a Grade 11 writer on the Life Board. She enjoys reading, writing and solving puzzles. She is also in desperate need of new books to read. So feel free to recommend any if you happen to see her.

name: Lillian Li
bio: Lillian Li is a Grade 11 student and the Outreach Manager for The Reckoner. She spends the majority of her time panicking, running away from discussions about test answers, getting lost (and forgetting to use Google Maps), asking for more pages (she was not informed that there was a finite number of sheets she could print with school printers on her account), and making study sheets.

name: Lovely Gebeyehu
bio: Lovely Gebeyehu, a 9th grade student, is a Life Board writer and hopes to give you a look into her thoughts, opinions, and mind. Not because their relevant or revolutionary, but rather because wants to prove that what's going on up there in our minds is both lovely and yet not - not half and half, but everything in between. Just as life isn't - can be, but endures to not.

name: Maxim Mohareb
bio: Maxim Mohareb is a writer. Maxim Mohareb is a thinker. Maxim Mohareb is a little bit radical. That's the best three adjectives Maxim can use to describe himself for Reckoner this the school year. He likes to write about things that irritate him as a way to figure them out more, and hope that you , as a reader, gain a different perspective on existing topics or learn about a new idea altogether while reading.

name: Michael Yang
bio: Michael is a G12 student.

name: Mohammad.Husein
bio: Meet Mohammad.Husein, a soccer enthusiast and devoted Canary lover. Whether kicking a ball on the field or cherishing the melodies of his Canaries, he finds joy in life's simple pleasures. With an adventurous spirit and boundless passion, he navigates the world, embracing every moment with enthusiasm.

name: Nevetha Arullinkam
bio: No bio available

name: Oriana Zhou
bio: Oriana is a writer on the editorial and news boards. As a grade 11 student, she can be found listening to music, reading, drawing, or taking a walk in the halls of Marc Garneau.

name: Patricia Zhang
bio: Patricia is a grade 11 student that loves writing, philosophy, and photography! In her free time she enjoys shopping and visiting cute cafes downtown.

name: Paul Shur
bio: Paul Shur is a grade 12 student who is currently the Editor In Chief of the Reckoner, and he's ecstatic for the upcoming school year. In his spare time, Paul likes to stand in front of a mirror and give himself pep talks. He enjoys reading and dislikes bubble tea. Feel free to say hi if you see him in the halls!

name: Sahana Sakthivel
bio: Sahana Sakthivel is an incredibly questionable student who loves to get creative with art. sketching Portraits is her favorite thing to do, and she's not bad at drawing and sketching either. Unfortunately, she doesn't have the same success with painting. Watercolour painting is particularly is difficult for her, but she still manages to express her creativity in her art in other ways. Tip, don’t ever ask her to paint something for you, she will traumatize you for life!

name: Salena Fatima
bio: Salena Fatima is an 11th grade writer for the Significant Digits board. She enjoys hiking, reading, and writing post apocalyptic stories in her free time. She can't wait for you guys to read the pieces she will be writing for The Reckoner this year!

name: Sarah Rodrigues
bio: Sarah is part of the Photography board for the Reckoner. Her hobbies include procrastinating, reading, and convincing herself that Lana Del Rey is an underground artist. On the weekend, you can find her aimlessly walking around, hoping to see something interesting. She can't wait for high school to be over, but she knows she'll feel nostalgic for it in the future.

name: Shiloh Zheng
bio: Shiloh is an 11th grader on the Illustrations board. Strong enough to move a pebble (probably).

name: Soha Sakhiani
bio: Soha, lovingly called 'the Brit', thrives most when she's alone swallowed inside her comforters or in the absolute shining chaotic spotlighted centre of attention. There is no in between. When Soha is not rooting for the anti-hero she is binge watching 2000s sitcoms wishing she was a 90s baby.

name: Sonia Ravindran
bio: Sonia is a Grade 11 Illustrator at the Reckoner. She enjoys making art, watching television/films and listening to music but usually works through her endless amount of homework. She would like to work in the architectural field or the film industry. You can find her either overthinking, being overdramatic or sleeping.

name: Susannah Welke
bio: Susannah is a grade 10 student on the Editorial board of the Reckoner’s 13th guard. She spends her spare time contemplating her existence pre-elamad test and watching Shameless. She is excited for another year with the Reckoner :)

name: Syeda Sadaf Jaffary
bio: A passionate artist and editor apart of the reckoners illustrations & print development board. In her free time, Sadaf listens to music, binges Netflix, reads books and spends time with her friends.

name: Tessa Nitescu
bio: Tessa Nitescu is a Grade 10 student. She is usually listening to a carefully cultivated ten hour playlist.

name: Thanusa Paskaran
bio: Thanusa Paskaran is a Grade 11 student who joined the Reckoner to pursue her love of literature. She enjoys reading, writing, listening to music, and watching anything horror related with the little free time that she has. When she isn't she overthinking, you can find her binging anything and everything on Netflix. Thanusa aspires to travel more and explore the world as much as she can in the future!

name: Veronica Davey-Young
bio: Veronica is a Grade 10 writer for the Editorial board. She is often found playing ultimate frisbee or trying to convince people to join the MGCI team and is always happy to talk about anything school, sports, or baking show-related!

name: Yameen Aziz
bio: Yameen is a grade 12 student serving on the Photography Board for the Reckoner. He spends his weekends nervously watching Arsenal matches, a long-standing tradition of his, as well as crying through recurring Scuderia Ferrari strategy mishaps. He enjoys quiet evenings with a good Albert Camus book, but is also known to jump at the opportunity to hang out with friends and family. If there is one thing to know about him, it's that asking him about his conflicting university choices is a one-way ticket to hours-long, dull monologue.

name: Yolanda Zhou
bio: i really like cats

name: Yuewen Gao
bio: Yuewen is the Illustrations Manager of the Twelfth Guard. She enjoys reading ridiculous Wikipedia pages, listening to music, sleeping, drawing, and scrolling endlessly through Tumblr.

name: Zaeem Mustafa
bio: Zaeem Mustafa is a grade 09 student. He is a news writer. In his free time, he plays badminton and he likes to solve puzzles. He enjoys playing sports, talking to friends. He loves meeting new people. Say hi to him in the halls!

name: Aamena Koya
bio: Aamena Koya is a grade 11 student. If shes not chugging her iced coffee shes probably dreaming about getting one. In her free time she is listening to podcasts, lifting at the gym, and reading books. Besides stressing about school she works on personal development and growing her bank account :)

name: Aishani Indu
bio: Aishani is the third-shortest person in Grade 11, anyone who tells you otherwise (perhaps people whose names start with M or H) are LYING. She enjoys looking for hiding spiders so that she can run away from that room immediately, and stubbing her foot in every sharp corner she doesn't notice.

name: Akshaya Varakunan
bio: Akshaya Varakunan is a Grade 12 student and member of the Life Board. As you are reading this, there is a 50% chance she is playing Word Blitz.

name: Allan Li
bio: Allan is a Grade 12 at MGCI. He enjoys taking photos of his friends. Check his photos out on his Instagram at @allan.liphotos. He is so excited to be a part of the Reckoner this year.

name: Alvin Young
bio: Alvin Young is writer and artist for the Life Board. He likes to draw and write (shocking!), play tennis, and dream. Dreams are a fascinating thing to him, and perhaps one day he'll discover one in real life.

name: Amy Long
bio: Amy Long has not a single intelligent thought behind those eyes.

name: Andrew Chen
bio: Andrew Chen is a grade 10 student at MGCI trying his best... He enjoys playing sports, listening to music, talking to friends and not worrying about tests. He loves meeting new people, writing stories and capturing life in the little things. Say hi to him around the halls!

name: Andy Sun
bio: Andy is a part-time tenner and a full-time idiot. Sometimes, he’s also a writer in editorial and news. Most of the time, he can be found performing a magic trick - making his free time vanish. He aspires to aspire, and to reach 6 feet (the only thing preventing him is the ruler you measure with !)

name: Anjali Gupta
bio: Anjali is a Grade 9 student at MGCI. She's most often found with her nose in a book and her head in the clouds. She loves dogs, the color purple, singing, and a billion other unrelated things. She loves making friends so reach out to her anytime!

name: Annie Xiong
bio: Annie is a 12th grade writer for the Life Board. She enjoys browsing Pinterest boards and online stores, jotting down poem ideas she’ll never write, and stockpiling blackmail photos of her friends. If anyone wants to cry together to Taylor Swift’s discography, she urges you to reach out.

name: Arabhi Kulamurugan
bio: Arabhi is a grade 12 student and is excited to work with the Reckoner. She's a music enthusiast - especially for The Weeknd - and loves anything to do with the sky such as sunsets, constellations, and rain. Her favourite show is Brooklyn 99 which she intends to rewatch after submitting this bio.

name: Bailey Min
bio: Bailey Min is a ninth grader at Marc Garneau C.I. Favourite activities of his include engaging with unfunny humour, reading, and staring blankly at walls. Email and pigeon are both accepted contact modes.

name: Chang Chang Li
bio: Chang is a grade 10 student at Marc Garneau Collegiate Insitute, a member of both the Editorial and Outreach Board. Whether it's scrawling down the strings of incoherency he considers writing or fumbling around attempting to finish all of his work, he's constantly in a state of entropic shock.

name: Colleen Chang
bio: Colleen Chang is a member of the Reckoner’s illustration board. She enjoys walking through neighborhoods, figure drawing, and finding cool movies that she keeps telling herself she’ll “watch later.” She hopes to one day improve her slow typing speed and become a professional illustrator.

name: Daniel Fan
bio: Daniel is the worst photographer to exist. He has a crippling addiction to nestea that you can abuse if you want him to get work done. Daniel likes to play clash royale in every class he can until his mark drops below 40. Don't be like Daniel.

name: Donna Zhang
bio: Donna started following you.

name: Dustin Xu
bio: Dustin likes Starbucks. He also finds difficulty in straining his neck down to talk to anyone below 165cm.

name: Eileen Kuang
bio: Eileen is a 10th grade Editorial writer for The Reckoner. She likes to play painful sports, solve painful problems, as well as find any excuse to use painfully particular diction. She hopes to someday achieve healthy posture and wake up at her first alarm of five.

name: Elliot Ngo
bio: Elliot is a grade 12 student and a member of the print board at the Reckoner.

name: Emily Liu
bio: Emily Liu is a grade 12 student and a long time member of the Life Board. She can usually be found playing Word Blitz or the NYT Crossword/Spelling Bee, when she's not busy on the grind. Feel free to say hi to her; she loves to meet people!

name: Enoch He
bio: Enoch He is a senior in the Web Development Board of The Reckoner. He is constantly battling procrastination every hour of the day, in high hopes of being productive. When Enoch is not worrying about his grades, he is wondering what he will be eating for his next meal.

name: Flora Chen
bio: Flora is in the 12th grade and writes crosswords for The Reckoner. She enjoys reading, running, watching hockey, listening to Taylor Swift & Ella Fitzgerald, and staring very vainly at her own handwriting.

name: Ivy Liu
bio: Ivy is a Grade 10 student at MGCI, and she is part of the Illustrations Board here at The Reckoner. She likes to travel, sleep for 12 hours straight, draw, and reread What If? by Randall Munroe for the 60th time (she should probably get the sequel already).

name: Jeremy Dai
bio: Jeremy is in Grade 11, which means that he gets all the privileges of being in the older half of high school: Working until 2 am to finish projects, bossing niners and tenners around, and chatting anyone up in the halls. Unfortunately, he has not escaped being a corporate slave to high marks.

name: Lisa Zhang
bio: Lisa is a writer for the life board. She can usually be found procrastinating and complaining about her “lack of time” in the same sentence. When she manages to salvage free time, you can find her chugging questionable amounts of bubble tea for the sugar rush or binging every Noah Kahan song ever.

name: Maggie Pang
bio: Hello, this person is a g11 writer for the life board. She was so excited to distance herself from her last year's bio, but recently read it and realised she really hasn't changed. So she will instead use this space to tell you she can be found every Friday lunch in room 307 at bridge club.

name: Mahnoor Irfan
bio: Mahnoor is a member of the Print Development Board at The Reckoner. She spends every day like it's her birthday. Her spare time is spent binge-watching k-dramas and complaining about having no spare time *Insert rolling eye emoji*. Her all-time favorite hobby is sleeping, which she deprives herself due to her very unfortunate habit of procrastinating. Additionally, She has a huge obsession with collecting old coins and hopes to make a fortune out of them one day.

name: Mahyar Yousefzadeh
bio: Mahyar Yousefzadeh is a member of MGCI Reckoner's Web board. At school, he can be seen reading, scrolling through reading, or listening to music. He can also be seen outside of school in parks and on trails, admiring the nature around him.

name: Mana Kheirkhah
bio: Mana Kheirkhah is a new grade 9 student at Marc Garneau Collegiate Institute. She is a studious and creative person with a wide range of interests including writing, sports, and music. Some things she especially enjoys doing include hanging out with friends, listening to music, and reading.

name: Miranda Zhao
bio: Miranda; 12th grader, editorial board. She is concise. (but mostly just lazy)

name: Omar Memon
bio: Omar Memon is a Grade 12 student at MGCI. He is passionate about reading, and math, and loves to complain about anything he can find to complain about. When he is not having an existential crisis, he is surprisingly fun! Feel free to reach out to him on Instagram at @omarsnotokay!

name: Paromita Roy
bio: Paromita Roy is a writer on the Editorial Board. In her free time, she enjoys writing, music, and crying about how much she loves the band TXT. You'll find her in the halls running between meetings, or being chased by her friends who insist on calling out her full name every time they see her.

name: Raheemah Patel
bio: Raheemah is a Grade 12 student & what most might consider an old soul. She loves books, baking, movies, cats, & more. A night owl & procrastinator by nature, she's often running on sleep (but aren’t we all?). She’s a little quiet, but loves meeting new people, so don’t be afraid to say hi!

name: Richard Xiong
bio: Richard Xiong is a Grade 9 photographer at the Reckoner. His routine for success is Discord modding for the day and starting assignments at 1 am. He enjoys playing the violin, speedcubing, being clownish, and annoying people online. Although he is short, he has a very good personality!!

name: Rida Manjoo
bio: Rida is a member of the Print Development Board at The Reckoner. Rida enjoys skating, reading, and travelling. When she's not scrolling through subreddits or playing music on repeat, she's drowning in a never-ending stream of sorrow. She truly can do it all!

name: Saivenkat Jilla
bio: Sai is a Grade 12 student in the TOPS program whose pastimes include gaming, swimming, and watching Youtube videos. He hopes to get a proper sleep schedule (never ask him when he slept—you don’t want to know) and improve his handwriting. You can usually find him running to his next class.

name: Sam Li
bio: Sam is a writer on the Reckoner—at least for now. He uses his limited free time on any, and everything related to debate. You'll find him wandering the halls chatting with his friends about basketball, games, and test results because he has nothing better to do, so come say hi if you see him.

name: Sophie Yee
bio: Sophie is a member of the Reckoner's Print Development team. Her hobbies include reading, winning, getting free stuff, playing games, listening to music, running, and hanging out with family and friends. She will shower you with praise if you present her with anything IKEA, sushi, or bubble tea!

name: Stephanie Chan
bio: Stephanie Chan is a Grade 11 student and a photographer for the Reckoner. She’s an avid fan of winter runs and can often be found listening to music or taking pictures of her friends. Her talents include being able to name a Taylor Swift song within 10 seconds and sending indecipherable texts.

name: Stephie Liu
bio: Stephie Liu is an author for the News Board. She is currently in Grade 12. Her hobbies include reading and gaming (occasionally). She also enjoys sleeping, sketching, listening to music, eating midnight snacks, and writing random short stories. She loves talking to others and making friends!

name: Sumit Paul
bio: Sumit Paul is a member of the Editorial Board at The Reckoner.

name: Tom Sharma
bio: Tom Sharma is a grade 9 student of MGCI and a member of Outreach and Significant digits. He sleeps a mere 4 hours a night and is an expert in the art of doing every assignment the night before. He enjoys snowboarding, competitive programming, excessive studying and contemplating poor life choices.

name: Vicky Wen
bio: Vicky Wen is a member of both the Outreach and Editorial boards. In their free time, they like to snap polaroids, have something mint on them at all times, and collect a horrendous amount of keychains.

name: Vivien Xiang
bio: Vivien Xiang is a grade 12 Life Board writer who's still surprised she made it this far. Her interests include thinking about murder, artificial intelligence, rhythm games, and uncomfortably large novels. If you say hi to her, she will say hi back and then promptly forget your existence.

name: Zaid Azhar
bio: Zaid is in grade 10 and is a member of the illustrations board. He enjoys drawing and has been drawing since birth. He also loves reading manga, listening to music and wandering around the city with his friends. He aspires to improve in art, to get good marks and to become a black belt in taekwondo.

name: Zixuan Xu
bio: Zixuan is a writer for the Life Board of the Reckoner. She wants everybody reading this to know that tomorrow is a new day, and it'll all be okay! You can visit her blog at https://wordsbyzi.tumblr.com/ for more poetry and short pieces.

name: Bala Venkataraman
bio: Bala Venkataraman is a grade 9 member of the photography board, who enjoys doing any kind of programming, from solving a CCC problem to making a TensorFlow neural network, solving problems in Math and Physics, playing videogames and taking cool pictures. He is usually seen on his computer, or with a camera in his hand.

name: Lucy Qi
bio: Lucy is a grade 11 Life artist and illustrator at the Reckoner. During her free time, you can find her playing volleyball, sleeping on her piano, doing karate, and drawing! Her goal for this year is to try to sleep at least 6 hours a day and procrastinate less, which is why she is submitting her bio 2 weeks early.

name: Jefferson Chen
bio: Jefferson Chen is the Deputy Editor-In-Chief and Manager for the Editorial Board for The Reckoner. Aside from his usual commitment to school, he serves as the Chief Warrant Officer at 110 Squadron of the Royal Canadian Air Cadets. Out of the academic world, Jefferson can usually be found on the piano, binge watching YouTube, or playing games on his 2013 PC. His games of choice are Minecraft and League of Legends.

name: Rain Yeyang
bio: Rain Yeyang is a grade 11 student. She is not good at writing bios.

name: Amy Jia
bio: Amy Jia is on the Editorial, Photography, and News boards in The Reckoner. This is her third year on The Reckoner now, but the only part of her that has changed is her height. However, she decided not to recycle her old biography just to spice things up. If you like reading, bubble tea, music, food, or squirrel pictures, then you know you definitely have something in common with her. She’s always happy to make new friends, so don’t be afraid to say hi or strike up a conversation!

name: Laksha Sivakumar
bio: Laksha Sivakumar is a dedicated ninth-grade student from Toronto, Canada. She was the recipient of the Science Award when she graduated elementary and the Academic Award when she completed middle school. Her dreams lived upon the stars since she was a child, which piqued her interest in astronomy. She aspires to work for the Canadian Space Agency. Along with her interest in STEM, she enjoys writing her life events, with each stage in a separate volume and play basketball. Overall, she is a well-rounded and goal-oriented individual who is delighted to work with The Reckoner's Editorial Board.

name: Rand Alahmad
bio: Rand Alahmad, professional bodybuilder.

name: Ray Hang
bio: Ray is a human being who is trying to learn how to properly manage time. Ray is in grade 11, and is part of the print and news boards. You should wave to Ray in the hallways. Ray likes indie pop music and classical/instrumental music. Ray also likes hugs, but COVID is a thing. Ray can usually be found hovering around several friend groups at the same time, as Ray cannot decide who to talk to.

name: Bill Yan
bio: Bill Yan is a member of the Photography, Print, and Life boards at The Reckoner. He is a curious student who loves doing math, playing the piano, taking pictures, designing, writing and exercising. During the quarantine, Bill has been exceptionally bored, has practiced writing sentences with too many commas, and tried to reduce his run-on sentences. He likes taking naps in his spare time as well. Bill is excited to be a member of the Eleventh guard this year.

name: Brian Li
bio: Brian Li is a Grade 10 student at Marc Garneau Collegiate institute, and a writer for the Editorial Board of The Reckoner's Eleventh Guard. He has previously written in the News Board. His hobbies include sleeping and playing games as quite possibly the most generic pastimes one can have. He is once again predicting an overt surplus of Reckoner biographies with the same Self-deprecating jokes™ concerning procrastination, the lack of spare time, and bubble tea.

name: Max Lu
bio: Max is an illustrator who picked up his interest in art the same time his peers dropped it. You can often find him clicking his keyboard to the beat of Japanese songs by hovering over RedcXca#4332. He has not taken a selfie since grade 10 but if you see a short man with long hair holding a hotdog and a Pepsi cup at lunch, that is him. He will give you a :thumbsup: and quickly run to his next class.

name: Iris Ma
bio: Iris is a writer for the News and Significant Digits boards this year. Accompanied by her signature banana bucket hat, you can often find her rambling on about some nonsense or babbling incoherently. She is best known for her unhealthy obsession over cookies and ramen, as well as an undying passion to become an infamous mafia boss. When talking to her, you may notice that she wiggles about frequently and seems to be incapable of pronouncing common vocabulary terms (resulting in a series of random noises).

name: Zahra Suhail
bio: While many may say Zahra's sarcasm is the only humor she has, she seems to have a lot more in store. Writing is her way of expression and the vision she has of the world. It's where words just perfectly melt together in a beautiful creation of art. She's glad to be a part of the Life Board, hoping her words will be heard, and most importantly, touch the hearts of many others.

name: Hiba Mulla
bio: Hiba Mulla Is an illustrator for The Reckoner. She loves to draw a lot. If you ever look at her homework, that's probably all you’ll ever see. If she’s not drawing you can find her playing games, binging an anime series, or running away from homework. She really likes sports such as volleyball, soccer, and karate. Otherwise she can be found procrastinating on assignments and homework. She’s unsure about the future but knows she wants to do something with art.

name: Angelina Wang
bio: Angelina Wang is a chipper and cheery Grade 10 student at Marc Garneau CI. She enjoys creating writing and poetry, sharing strong opinions, and making sick rhymes. She also likes spending her time playing sports and making music.

name: James Zhang
bio: James Zhang is a Grade 9 student who was bored and decided to join Significant Digits and The Reckoner so he can do stuff. Life is quite boring for him. All he does is wake up, go to school, do work, eat, and sleep. He wishes that time could slow down so he has time do all his favourite activities, of which there are too many. Some of his include playing instruments, fiddling with technology, and doing lots of work. The internet is his source of life and without it, he would probably go insane.

name: Carrie Jiang
bio: Carrie Jiang is a Grade 11 member of the Outreach Board. For the past two years being in The Reckoner, she found herself stumped on writing a simple biography, but was reminded that she could easily rant about her spiraling addiction to Netflix. However, this year is different. She would like to mention that she is months sober from Netflix (excluding a short relapse for Squid Game) and now spends more time doing other things that she enjoys. She loves hanging out with friends, reading, playing piano, making extremely funny jokes, and sleeping (something she rarely gets to do).

name: Nuha Samen
bio: Nuha Samen is a grade 10 student and is a part of the Print Development Board at The Reckoner. At school, she loves learning about space and computers. In her free time, Nuha is either baking, listening to true crime podcasts, or redecorating her room for the 30080126th time. She is also willing to sell her soul for a British Shorthair Cat (preferably with a British accent). <3

name: Wenzhao Pan
bio: Wenzhao is a grade 11 student at Marc Garneau CI, and a member of the Outreach and Editorial boards. In his spare time, he likes to play basketball, destroy people at iMessage games, and annoy his friends. When he isn't doing any of these, he is probably procrastinating or listening to his Spotify liked songs on shuffle (or both). Please feel free to reach out to him anytime, he loves making new friends!

name: Selvahini Kamalarajan
bio: Selvahini Kamalarajan is a grade 10 student at Marc Garneau CI. Her hobbies include playing the keyboard, reading and browsing the dark depths of the internet. She is obsessed with the crash course philosophy series and searches up random things in her free time. Selvahini often ponders about the existence of extraterrestrial life and contemplates her life choices. On the rare occasion where she isn’t having an existential crisis, you can probably catch her being busy doing nothing. Selvahini hopes to achieve clarity in her life and know the answer to why her name autocorrects to “selvamani” on google docs.

name: Javeria Sajid
bio: Javeria Sajid is a writer for the Life Board at the Reckoner. She’s addicted to reading and you’ll always find her with a book - even when she has a hundred other things to do. When she’s not reading, she chooses to spend her time by baking delicious treats, eating them, and lazing about. Her mind is a jumble of random thoughts and worlds. Pages upon pages of notes, ideas, and one-sentence-drafts waiting to be let out in a flurry of repressed potential, which she then translates into written pieces.

name: Julia Shen
bio: Julia Shen is a member of the Reckoner’s Print Development Board. She loves eating snacks, listening to music, and power-napping on every car ride possible. If she’s not busy questioning some aspect of her life (her wack music taste being the latest cause for concern) while stress-folding cranes (the only origami she knows how to make), she’s probably lamenting her lack of progress in her quest to catch up on all the anime she promised to binge. Family, friends, and plushies are the loves of her life, though she often struggles to express her appreciation for the first two.

name: Derek Chen
bio: Derek is in grade 10, and is a writer for the Editorial Board. He claims he has goals in life, but if you ask him about them, he has to think on the spot. His passions include fencing and playing the violin, and he is bad at both. He is a dad joke enthusiast and loves to annoy his friends with punny jokes and watch them cringe. To find him, search in corners where he could be crying.

name: Yusra Mukhtar
bio: Yusra Mukhtar is a writer for The Reckoner. She loves to read, write, and eat. She’s someone who gets too emotionally invested in books and the different worlds authors create. More than half of her conversations are about books, and once she starts, you won’t be able to get her to stop. Yusra can’t help but procrastinate when it comes to work, no matter how guilty she feels afterward.

name: Gavin Xue
bio: Gavin Xue is a writer for the Significant Digits Board at The Reckoner. He plays the piano, which is his go-to fact about himself for introductions, along with getting separated from his parents on a subway in China. When not chipping away at work, you’ll find him surfing the web, playing games, writing, and of course, regretting not doing the work.

name: Ada Aksoy
bio: Ada Aksoy is a writer for the Reckoner's Editorial Board. Ada loves thinking about the most controversial things to write in his head, and you'll occasionally find him bothering other people during lunch. He likes reading, discussing, debating, and anything like that. Fortunately, it is hard to find him because he is part of a collection of individuals who refer to themselves as John.

name: Joshua Zhuang
bio: Josh is a grade 9 writer for the Editorial and SigDig boards. He enjoys travelling, writing, and complaining about life to his friends. Cilantro and math are his two worst enemies, and at this point in life procrastination is pretty much his hobby. In his spare time, you can find him napping, catching the latest movie, or mindlessly wandering around downtown. He likes downtown maybe just a little bit too much.

name: Helen Lin
bio: Helen is a grade 10 photographer for The Reckoner and your local genshin addict. In her free time, you can catch her staring at her phone, lost in a game of Genshin Impact, or scrolling through Instagram and looking at her beloved Hamilton memes. Contrary to popular belief, she actually does do work, albeit with a lot of procrastination, and occasionally finishes it. What happens to the work she doesn’t finish... no one dares question the ashes that float through the sky at night.

name: Hateem Fatima
bio: Hateem Fatima is a writer for the Life Board. During her free time, she likes to watch videos of true crime. She's always fascinated by the criminal mind. Anyway, if you ever see her at school, don't be shy to say hi!

name: Nishtha Patel
bio: Nishtha Patel is a Grade 11 student part of the Editorial and Outreach boards on The Reckoner this year. Over quarantine, she has found a greater appreciation for journalism which is what drew her to The Reckoner. When she isn’t reading a book, she is imagining herself in the book because she has several complaints about reality. Nishtha loves to play sports or do outdoor activities but can also be found finishing 18 season-long shows within days. She has immaculate music taste so feel free to reach out any time for recommendations...she is very friendly!

name: Iffat Iqbal
bio: Iffat Iqbal is a Grade 9 student at MGCI. He also happens to be a a member of the Editorial Board. He is normally found procrastinating, producing blood cells, breathing, and contemplating the meaning of life! His favourite animal is the chimpanzee and he dislikes the concept behind chocolate cake.

name: Rena Liu
bio: Rena is a grade 12 student at MGCI and a senior news writer for The Reckoner. Her hobbies include vibing to music, sleeping (read: not getting enough sleep), reading, playing games, and procrastinating. You can probably find her suffering from math, physics, or chemistry on a regular basis.

name: Samaya Sadiq
bio: Samaya Sadiq is a Life Writer for The Reckoner. She is mostly procrastinating and stressing over everything at the same time. She enjoys baking, but only when no one is in the kitchen bothering her, reading and talking to her online friends. Recently, all she's been doing is obsessing over Harry Styles's love on tour outfits and being jealous of everyone who gets to see him live.

name: Brian Yan
bio: Brian Yan is a Grade 11 developer for The Reckoner’s Web and App Development board. In his spare time, he enjoys competitive programming, solving math problems, and playing basketball.

name: Luck Xing
bio: Luck is a grade 9 writer for the Life and Editorial boards with a great talent in time management, submitting his work on an average of four seconds before the due date. He enjoys torturing himself with math and fissiks as a side hobby and can’t stop talking about how hot and curvy sine functions are. He has a cat and a furry Instagram page – the cat’s cute, though. And as a licensed iMessage games addict, he will bet his life on eight ball. But please, don’t send him any word games; he will literally cry.

name: Leah Huang
bio: Leah’s a member of Outreach. She’s a manic pixie dream girl without the manic, pixie and dream parts. She’s unfortunately in Gr. 10. True lover of night time photos and sunrise acro-yoga sessions. She prefers dawn but admits that dusk is a prettier word. Hit her up if you want to talk about fashion, baking, chemistry, sports or pretty girls. Win her over using flattery.

name: Samara Rahman
bio: Samara is a Grade 10 illustrator for The Reckoner. In her free time, she enjoys biking, binge watching anime and overplanning every aspect of her life. At night she avoids sleep at all costs, often chilling to Spotify, scramming to finish work due in a few hours (such as this biography), procrastinating even more or talking to her friends on Discord, frequently all 4 at the same time.

name: Aaron Zhang
bio: A member of the editorial board, he cannot bear to type his own name. Likely holds the opinion that the best immortality timeline exists in the "Arc of a Scythe" book series by Neal Shusterman and that luck is made, not had. He can be seen recreationally wearing a tie.

name: Anthony Chen
bio: Anthony Chen loves coding, so it’s no surprise that he’s been a developer for the Reckoner’s Web Development Board for the past three years running. When he’s not dealing with angry complaints that the Reckoner’s website is down, you can find him either plotting against his allies at the Diplomacy club or abusing robots at the Robotics club. If you ever want to distract him, just start a conversation about open source software, geopolitics, cryptocurrency, or all three at once.

name: Angela Xu
bio: Angela Xu is a Grade 11 photographer for the Reckoner. As the professional procrastinator that she is, she started writing this the night before it was due. She enjoys many activities including soccer, people-watching, word hunt, and drinking bubble tea, all of which she did while putting off writing this bio.

name: Richard Zhu
bio: Richard Zhu is a grade 12 student at Marc Garneau. He loves his bed, but rarely ever gets to sleep in it for more than 5 hours each night. He also loves his backpack, for that is where he puts his belongings. Last but not least, he loves his clothes, so much so that he wears them almost every day.

name: Emma Wai
bio: Emma Wai is the Editor in Chief of The Reckoner. She spends her days eating, studying, and editing. (Also, not sleeping enough, which she tends to deprive herself of due to her unfortunate habit of procrastinating.) Although Emma is often busy jumping around on a trampoline or pretending to study for her next test, she's always available if you need to talk, argue, and/or complain about the latest headline. You can find her hanging around in bubble tea shops, sleeping on the TTC, getting obsessed with phone games for short periods of time, or coming up with chat nicknames that everyone—well, mostly Emma—finds hilarious.

name: Fatima Sharipova
bio: Fatima Sharipova is a Life Writer for the Reckoner. She is currently a senior. Believe it or not, she is actually extroverted—she loves to talk and meet new people, although you probably won’t catch her doing it. Lately, you can find her catching up on schoolwork on the bus, at bus stops, and on the streets on Saturdays. She will try to find a library to camp at between shifts moving forward. Hide your cultures, look both ways before you cross the street (she might be behind the wheel), and please go skating with her immediately.

name: Ajita Kanthathasan
bio: Ajita Kanthathasan is an illustrator for The Reckoner. In her final year of high school, she is both incredibly motivated and completely sapped of every last bit of her energy. She's simultaneously ready to write an essay on why south Asian sweets are in fact the best type of dessert and take a three week long nap. The only thing truly keeping her going is hopping from one hyperfixation to the next, but don't ask her about it as she will completely forget every single one of her interests the minute she is questioned about them.

name: Michelle Zhou
bio: Michelle is a member of the Print Development Board. She joined the Reckoner during the last semester of her last year of high school as a form of closure after being rejected in the first semester of her first year of high school. What she lacks in her Mandarin Chinese abilities is made up for by her ever-growing assortment of Amusing Anseriforme Apparel (or Wacky Waterfowl Wear :D) Want to know more about Michelle? She will trade you one fun fact about herself in return for one business card for her collection.

name: Zayaan Ikram
bio: Zayaan is a writer who’s pretty blunt in his writing, because that’s just his style. He does not know how to pose for photos, and that will be the death of him. If you find him, hesitate to say hi. He is very socially inept.

name: Nikolas Zahariadis
bio: Nikolas is a photographer for the Reckoner. He is regularly found wandering the streets with his camera trying to capture the city from his own perspective. He is an adrenaline junkie and loves mountain biking and flying, as well as anything that has an engine in it. He is also very petit, standing at 6’3 and towering over everyone. When he isn’t actively looking for activities that will kill him, he is commonly found napping. Although you may think he is crazy, his dream is to become a photographer and express himself through his photography.

name: Aadila Ali Sabry
bio: Aadila is a member of the Web Board at The Reckoner. Some of her talents include: pulling all-nighters without coffee, doing handstands against the wall, and spelling antidisestablishmentarianism backwards. This is not an exhaustive list.

name: Abbinaya Parakaran
bio: Abbinaya Parakaran is a writer for The Reckoner's Life Board. She is a passionate reader and writer. She's also an amazing procrastinator. In her free time, she loves to eat snacks and binge watch TV shows.

name: Akil Huang
bio: Akil Huang is a member of The Reckoner's Editorial Board. He heads the MGCI Debate Club and works tirelessly to make sure that everyone knows it. He can be found playing the Kalimba, buying clothes, or talking about his Kindle. Message Akil to discuss fashion and politics.

name: Allyson Wu
bio: Allyson Wu is a Grade 10 student at MGCI and the head of the Outreach Board at The Reckoner. During her free time, she can usually be found listening to music on Spotify, drawing on her phone, or curled up with a book. Her current aspirations include becoming more fluent in Mandarin, improving her messy handwriting, and trying to increase her Among Us win rate. Feel free to reach out to her anytime, even if it's just to say hi - she loves making friends!

name: Alviya Siddiqui
bio: Alviya Siddiqui is a member of the Outreach Board at The Reckoner. Alviya is usually busy trying to keep up with the latest Netflix shows, though she is always within easy reach to obsess over fictional characters, rant about the homework she always, somehow, fails to complete, and discuss abstract concepts, such as career pathways. From academics and extracurriculars acting as Serotonin to family and friends acting as Dopamine, together these make up a perfect blend of balance in Alviya’s life.

name: Anirudh Goel
bio: Anirudh Goel is a Grade 11 writer for The Reckoner’s Significant Digits board. His day usually starts off with a missed workout session substituted with an additional hour of sleep. He loves to travel the world and try out new experiences all while listening to either English or Bollywood music. He can often be seen fixing his hairstyle or turning on comedian mode for his friends. He tries to live in the moment so be sure to be around him for a fun time. Feel free to hit him up on Instagram where even KSI follows him!! @_anirudhgoel

name: Brasen Xu
bio: Having been somehow accepted onto The Reckoner, Brasen Xu is now a writer for the Life board. In his limited free time, Brasen mindlessly watches YouTube videos. Brasen also enjoys doing DMOJ problems (AKA banging his head against a brick wall). His other hobbies include reading web novels and playing guitar. Brasen’s favourite fruit is the tangerine, and his favourite music is Mongolian throat singing. If he could be any country, Brasen would probably be Latvia, a country with 12,000 rivers and 3,000 small lakes. If you spot him in the hallway, he is probably sleepwalking.

name: Chen Peng
bio: Chen Peng is a Grade 11 is a programmer for The Reckoner’s Web and App Development board. Although it may be strenuous to comprehend from the look of his profile page, Chen enjoys playing sports and going out with his friends. The quarantine has not been kind to him so he plans to start shaving off the bulk once he manages to pass one of Ms. Hermanovsky’s biology examinations. Thus to our dismay, one may conclude he will not be hitting the weights any time soon.

name: Conner Lee
bio: Conner’s a shut in who barely left his house for the past nine months due to COVID-19, which works out pretty nicely because of his extreme distaste for sunlight and exercise. He should probably be writing about his quirks and hobbies in this section of the bio but does anyone actually read this thing?

name: Cynthia Wang
bio: Cynthia Wang is the Director of Web Development of The Reckoner. Since the beginning of quarantine, she's pretty much spent her entire life playing video games. During the rare times she decides to be productive, she is probably making tiny study notes, jamming to music while reading boring English literature, squinting at math formulas with Twitch streams on in the background, or crying in a corner over the (at the time of writing this biography) broken state of thereckoner.ca. Although she will assert dominance on you if necessary, you can usually win her over with cheesecake.

name: Daniel Neagu
bio: Daniel is a senior writer for Life and Editorial at The Reckoner. He enjoys rap music and can be found nodding along to Kanye West. Overall he's pretty Kanye fresh. His hobbies include tax evasion, world domination and eventually beating Minecraft. During his time at Garneau he's successfully mastered the art of missing the 925 bus home, and then the next one after that. Dmoney ultimately hopes that one day the pandemic will end and the hotdog stand will come back. Until then, he wishes you Kanye's best.

name: Edward Yang
bio: Edward Yang was born at a very young age. His childhood was spent in Mississauga, but he moved to Markham right before he started Grade 4. Edward is currently in Grade 9, and enjoys fencing, reading about the latest science news, and talking to his friends on Discord.

name: Emily Lai
bio: Emily Lai is a writer for the Life Board and an Illustrator of The Reckoner. In her spare time, she plays piano, reads classic novels, and makes a valiant attempt at learning foreign languages. In another life, she imagines herself living quietly in the countryside with an abundance of good tea, books, and plenty of trees to read under.

name: Evelyn Jiang
bio: Evelyn is a photographer and news writer at The Reckoner. Her notable talents include starting assignments at 12 am and sleeping through all of her alarms. Evelyn is also proud to announce that she has traded her bubble tea addiction for a Chipotle obsession. She aspires to one day be 5’3 and achieve a first grade level of fluency in Mandarin.

name: Fatima Gulab
bio: Fatima Gulab is an artist for the Life Board. She spends her time grieving Achilles and Patroclus and wondering what Sanrio character she is most like (probably cinnamonroll). Convincing her friends to listen to The Smiths is one of her hardest struggles but she is able to find middle ground with TWICE. Unlike most people, Fatima has seen two pretty best friends.

name: Helen Sun
bio: Helen Sun is an Illustrator at The Reckoner. She loves the colour yellow, bridge, astronomy, podcasts, pop art, and book prose. She can be found fooling around with the motion blur functions in her art program instead of actually working on the piece. Her current concern: everyone around her has god-like handwriting and she desperately wants in.

name: Howard Ou
bio: Howard Ou is a Grade 11 Editorial writer for the Reckoner. He enjoys playing badminton, which he has been playing for over 5 years, reading science fiction novels, and computer programming. In his free time, Howard can almost always be found playing diep.io.

name: India Das-Brown
bio: India writes for both the Life and Editorial boards at The Reckoner. She is a writer who writes what she reckons and a reckoner who reckons herself a writer. When bored, India likes to walk around town. She also enjoys looking at things, being with people, astral travelling, and the cemetery. !!

name: Jacqueline Huo
bio: Jacqueline Huo is the Editor in Chief of The Reckoner. She’s developed some bad habits, most notably procrastinating on assignments by watching sitcoms and writing run-on sentences, especially when talking about her interests, including, but not limited to, Animal Crossing, the Simon Snow book series, and the musical Hamilton—which she’s been obsessed with since she first listened to the cast recording in middle school, back when she still had a blue streak in her hair and a decent sleep schedule that didn’t involve being awake after midnight or needing caffeine to function like a normal human being.

name: Jeffrey Cheung
bio: He is the Director of Print Development. He attends Marc Garneau Collegiate Institute, and is also a part of The Reckoner. He has hobbies. Sometimes, he browses internet websites and other such things. Other times, he will do the occasional activity or hear a song. He is just like you. He works hard, enjoys things, and pumps blood from his heart around his body roughly 115,200 times per day. His favourite animal is the frog and he is in Grade 11.

name: Jessica Xiong
bio: Jessica Xiong is the Photography Manager for The Reckoner. She is a Grade 12 student who aspires to make the world a better place and to stop procrastinating (but she always leaves that for another day). She enjoys playing the violin, taking photos, listening to music, and playing with her two cats. In the rare opportunity of something called “Free Time,” she can be found madly trying to catch up on TV shows and Webtoons while eating junk food, spamming her friends online, and taking long naps.

name: Kelly Wang
bio: Kelly Wang is a writer for The Reckoner’s Life Board. She enjoys cooking and baking, but especially, the part after, when she gets to eat. One of her talents is being able to binge TV shows at incredible speeds; currently, she is on a One Piece binge. In the future, she hopes to travel to Europe and figure out what she actually wants to do in life. She loves going out, whether that is getting bubble tea or going thrift shopping, she enjoys every second. She finds school passable, but would much rather be at home, cuddling with her dog.

name: Kevin Wang
bio: Kevin Wang is a writer for the Significant Digits Column, where he reports on numbers abstractions world events weekly. He was born at a young age in a third-person country, which partially explains why he’s writing like this. (As a bonus, it makes him sound very official.) He spends his unfree time fighting corona beer virus by drinking water and tapioca instead, writing on his blog Definitely Integrals, and plotting to free Marc Garneau from the display case outside the office. If he had more time he would have written a shorter bio.

name: Lauren Liu
bio: Lauren Liu is the Illustrations Manager at The Reckoner. When she is not busy with schoolwork and extracurricular activities, she can be found reading a good novel, eating yummy food, or watching Netflix. She believes that art is one of the many powerful mediums that can be used for de-stressing while self-expressing as well as for bringing a community together. If you ever see her on a walk outside in her neighbourhood, you can find her contemplating about life and how the world works.

name: Linda Cai
bio: Linda is a member of the outreach board. She enjoys binge-watching anime and silly videos when she needs to get things done. For example now while writing this bio. She is also able to survive up to 18 hours with no sleep or coffee, but that can ends up with her sleeping for another 14 hours straight.

name: Maryam Mobashir
bio: Maryam Mobashir is a writer for The Reckoner's Editorial Board and an artist for the Life Board. She is usually sleep deprived because of her extremely busy schedule and her tendency to stay up late reading. In her free time, she can be found immersed in a book, watching an episode of a show, or staring blankly into space occupied with her thoughts, oblivious to the world around her.

name: Nuha Khan
bio: Nuha Khan is a writer for the Editorial Board at The Reckoner. Her hobbies include sketching on everything from napkins to math notebooks, incessantly reading fantasies, and Taekwondo. She tried getting into basketball at one point, but sports aren’t really her thing. When not reading or writing up something new, you’ll probably find her taking a morning walk while listening to BTS songs, or overplanning her life on Notion, if that’s a thing. Her friends think it’s crazy, but she prides herself on waking up at 5 am every day since middle school - someone please get her some coffee.

name: Prithika Piratheepan
bio: Prithika is a member of the Print Board who truly enjoys graphic designing (though after designing the yearbook during the pandemic she constantly rethinks that). During her free time, and especially the winter, she enjoys reading while snuggled in bed with hot chocolate by her bedside. If you ever see her around you could probably find her silently crying due to the death of her favourite characters in books. She is always looking to meet new friends so stop by and talk to her about books or the NBA!

name: River Wei
bio: River Wei is a writer for the Life and Editorial boards. A majority of their time is spent on social media or experiencing secret emotions—often both at the same time. A majority of their character has been built from the multiple failed assassination attempts against them. It’s recommended that you stay at least five feet away from them at any given time in case they start oozing toxic waste. Just to be safe.

name: Sarah Ali
bio: Sarah Ali is the Editorial Manager. She enjoys writing about rising technologies and social and human rights issues. She tends to write unnecessarily harsh criticisms of anything and everything. Sarah also loves to discuss different issues with her peers, which is a dangerous game to play considering how she cries in every argument. She can often be found aimlessly wandering the halls and walking in and out of random clubs, although she now mostly cries in the comfort of her own home. She wishes to someday have a cat that can soothe her incessant weeping.

name: Sarah Li
bio: Sarah Li is an energetic tenner neck-deep in nonsense and daydreams. She's spent the past eight years of her life dedicating all of her time and energy to her novel series in-planning "CDP" and has essentially merged her soul with the thing. She landed herself as an illustrator and life board creator for the Reckoner by disguising the CDP as content. When she's not drafting up character arcs, rewriting physics, or finding increasingly creative ways to work around residual plotholes from Grade 2, she's... still thinking about the CDP. Seriously dude, get a hobby.

name: Sophie Yang
bio: Sophie Yang is an illustrator for the Reckoner‘s life board. She lives the hard life of a fangirl, which entails the unfortunate combination of a constant lack of sleep and being perpetually broke from buying songs and concert tickets. Her greatest aspirations include using her art to make a social and cultural impact, and of course—meeting Harry Styles.

name: Sumedh Dhanvanthry
bio: Sumedh Dhanvanthry is the manager of the Life Board. He’s in Grade 11, and struggles to recall how he got here. He speculates that learning to drive will teach him to be more focused on the journey than the destination. One can find him engaged in some task or another, sometimes writing, sometimes unthinking. He often waits to take his turn. His life often takes weighty turns. You might run into him, or he’ll run into you. He contains multitudes, but he’s constantly cucumber-cool. You know him well now— that’s all there is to it.

name: Sunyah Tehreem
bio: Sunyah Tehreem is an editorial board writer at The Reckoner. She usually gets really absorbed in the moment while she's doing something she likes, so sorry if she doesn't reply to your texts right away. She loves reading, almost all sports, the outdoors, and debating her friends and family on almost anything. Her friends and family call her “stubborn, ” but what she thinks they mean is opinionated. She hopes that she can write meaningfully for The Reckoner.

name: Theodore Lam
bio: Theodore Lam is a Grade 10 student at MGCI. His skills include procrastinating, spilling food, and losing his personal possessions. In his free time, he can be found reading Wikipedia articles, doing crossword puzzles, and looking for his personal possessions. He would tell you more about himself, but his home is currently being invaded by an army of rabid wallabies.

name: Tina Ma
bio: Tina Ma is a writer for the Editorial Board at The Reckoner. She enjoys jumping rope, moving things around her room and calling it “cleaning”, and looking through her friends’ Spotify playlists. She’s currently unable to wave at people who won’t wave back to her in the hallways since she’s attending virtual school, though she’s happy to report that her reply game has improved since Grade 10. In her spare time, she can be found editing videos for her new YouTube channel. She hopes that one day she’ll become internet famous and rich enough to buy a Maserati.

name: Tina Wei
bio: Tina Wei is a writer for the Life and Editorial boards. A majority of their time is spent on social media or experiencing secret emotions—often both at the same time. A majority of their character has been built from the multiple failed assassination attempts against them. It’s recommended that you stay at least five feet away from them at any given time in case they start oozing toxic waste. Just to be safe.

name: Urooba Shaikh
bio: Urooba Shaikh is a Grade 12 student at MGCI and a writer for the news and editorial boards at The Reckoner. She can usually be found scrambling to finish the homework she should have done earlier. In her spare time she likes to do many things that she is not good at, such as playing sports, singing, painting, and cooking. The three things she loves most in the world are food, books, and sleep, but she usually doesn’t get enough of any of them. She hopes to one day write something that will make the world a better place.

name: Wing Chang
bio: Wing Chang is a Grade 9 writer for the News Board. As a Zigzabob alien from Mars, she enjoys binge-reading (a mostly healthy obsession) and playing all the latest Google Doodle games, a.k.a. Magic Cat Academy.

name: Zahra Ahmed
bio: Zahra Ahmed is a Grade 10 student at MGCI and a news writer for The Reckoner. If she's not sipping coffee during the school day, she's probably planning her next coffee run. She usually complains about having too much work to do, or the opposite, having absolutely nothing to do. Sometimes, both at the same time. She takes pride in having taken a selfie with a llama, her obsession with to-do lists, and laughing uncontrollably.

name: Zarmeen Yaqoob
bio: Zarmeen Yaqoob is the News Manager at The Reckoner. Some of her special talents include overthinking and making jokes that she thinks are hilarious (though some may disagree). Even though she has taken on way more responsibilities than she probably should, she still has masterfully perfected the art of procrastination. When she is not busy overcomplicating everything, she can be found obsessing over a book, hanging out with friends, or stressing over nothing; sometimes all three at the same time. In any other circumstances, she would have loved to meet you in the school hallways, but it’s kind of illegal right now so probably best not to.

name: Zoe Cheng
bio: Zoe is a Grade 11 illustrator for the Reckoner. She is always looking for new learning opportunities and loves to help others. In her free time, Zoe enjoys various artistic activities and sports like skiing or boxing. She is also an outdoorsy person, so expect to see her going on a lot of camping/wilderness trips. She hopes to study biomedical engineering in the future, and be able to convey emotions to people through her art for The Reckoner.
